purpose: Public-safe prompt content for the Techniek Engineering project-history prompt console. Refine this file weekly from approved local project-history uploads and current public source links.

publicUse: Approved case-study lessons with client details removed
Contemporary engineering and project-management source links
doNotPublish: Unapproved Google Drive or local file contents
Credentials or past performance details not approved for public use

centerPrompt.title: Ask about Techniek's Project History
centerPrompt.prompt: Use Techniek's approved project-history library and current public engineering sources to summarize relevant experience themes for a commercial or industrial client. Keep the answer concise, practical, and free of private client details.
centerPrompt.answer: Techniek's public project history should read as practical capability themes: engineering judgment, organized project delivery, energy-performance thinking, field-ready documentation, and clear owner/operator next steps. As the local library grows, this prompt can rotate from broad themes to specific approved lessons by discipline.
actions: Start with the client's project type, facility type, and decision they need to make.
Match the question to an approved project-history theme or current field lesson.
Route detailed scoping questions to the contact form or support finder.

deepDivePrompts.title: Mechanical systems and reliability
deepDivePrompts.prompt: Review the approved mechanical project-history folder and current field links to identify how Techniek can help with equipment questions, mechanical-system reviews, maintenance decisions, commissioning issues, or technical second opinions.
deepDivePrompts.answer: Use this prompt to surface practical mechanical support such as equipment review, issue triage, maintenance planning, operating constraints, commissioning questions, and concise technical memos.
actions: Ask what asset, system, or failure mode is involved.
Request approved drawings, trend data, photos, reports, or inspection notes when needed.

deepDivePrompts.title: Civil and facility infrastructure
deepDivePrompts.prompt: Review the approved civil project-history folder and current infrastructure links to identify civil, site, facility, condition, risk, and asset-management questions Techniek can organize into a practical next step.
deepDivePrompts.answer: Use this prompt when a visitor has infrastructure, facility condition, documentation, risk, or planning questions and needs a concise technical path forward.
actions: Clarify whether the issue is planning, condition review, coordination, or risk.
Recommend a field-verification or documentation step before major decisions.

deepDivePrompts.title: Project controls and recovery
deepDivePrompts.prompt: Review the approved project-management folder and current project-delivery links to recommend how Techniek can help reset a delayed, unclear, or risk-heavy technical project.
deepDivePrompts.answer: Use this prompt for project controls, coordination, open decisions, RFI/submittal cleanup, stakeholder reporting, action lists, and risk registers.
actions: Ask for current phase, open issues, responsible parties, and schedule pressure.
Build a short action list and decision log.
Create a weekly status rhythm that separates facts, risks, and next actions.

deepDivePrompts.title: Energy-management opportunity scan
deepDivePrompts.prompt: Review the approved energy project-history folder and current energy-management links to identify commercial or industrial savings opportunities using bills, schedules, BAS trends, and operational constraints.
deepDivePrompts.answer: Use this prompt to turn energy data into practical actions: utility review, schedule drift, BAS trend checks, demand spikes, operating waste, and measurement plans.
actions: Ask for utility bills, interval data, occupancy or production schedules, and BAS trends.
Flag anomalies that can be verified by operators.
Tie each recommendation to an owner, expected impact, and follow-up check.

weeklyUpdateChecklist: Add new raw artifacts to the correct local knowledge_uploads subfolder.
Create a short approved summary with private details removed.
Rotate public link names from broad field trends to approved Techniek project-history themes as evidence grows.
Keep each prompt answer actionable and short enough to scan.
Update the date field after review.
